observations.behavior: Replaces the previous cache-refresh selection and reporting with a bounded, bounded-by-limit selection and a before/after backlog accounting.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the Redis sorted-set range returned the configured limit, distinguishing a drained queue from a queue that still has work behind the current run.

observations.behavior: Adds a before-sample of the backlog to the refresh run, and pushes both before and after backlog and oldest-expiry to Pushgateway.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the monitoring system to distinguish between a queue that is growing and one that is being cleared, rather than relying on a single after-sample which could be zero even if the queue is growing.
